summary: Correct, minimal fix: extends the VLA comparison branch to cover 'Q' (64-bit descriptor) variable-length arrays in addition to 'P' (32-bit), which is exactly the case the bug report exercises (format 'QD'). The accompanying rewrite to np.where makes the return type a tuple-of-ndarray, consistent with the other branches and functionally equivalent downstream.

issues.description: No inline comment noting that 'P'/'Q' denote 32-bit/64-bit VLA descriptor formats and why both need allclose-based comparison; would aid future maintainers but not blocking.
The 'P' branch return type changes from tuple-of-list to tuple-of-ndarray via np.where; downstream usage (len(diffs[0]), zip(*diffs)) is unaffected, so regression risk is negligible.
